preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and stdin.isdigit() and 1 <= len(stdin) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of digits with length at most 10^6

postconditions.expression: stdout == a + '+' + b + '=' + c and 1 <= len(a) < len(stdin) and 1 <= len(b) < len(stdin) - len(a) and 1 <= len(c) < len(stdin) - len(a) - len(b) and a + b == c and a[0] != '0' or len(a) == 1 and b[0] != '0' or len(b) == 1 and c[0] != '0' or len(c) == 1 and a.isdigit() and b.isdigit() and c.isdigit() and a + b + c == stdin
postconditions.description: stdout is a valid expression of the form a+b=c where a, b, c are non-empty digit subsequences of stdin without leading zeros, a+b=c holds mathematically, and stdout reconstructs stdin when '+' and '=' are removed
